text: It was very dark. <break time="0.8s" /> And the wind howled horribly. <break time="0.8s" /> Around Dorothy. <break time="0.8s" /> But after the first few whirls. <break time="0.8s" /> The house rocked gently. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a babys cradle. <break time="0.8s" /> Toto did not like it. <break time="0.8s" /> And he ran about the room. <break time="0.8s" /> Barking loudly. <break time="0.8s" /> Once he fell. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the open trap door. <break time="0.8s" /> And Dorothy thought. <break time="0.8s" /> She had lost him. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon, however. <break time="0.8s" /> She saw one of his ears. <break time="0.8s" /> Sticking up through the hole. <break time="0.8s" /> The strong pressure of the air. <break time="0.8s" /> Was holding him up. <break time="0.8s" /> So he could not fall. <break time="0.8s" /> She crept to the hole. <break time="0.8s" /> Caught Toto by the ear. <break time="0.8s" /> And dragged him into the room again. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she closed the trap door. <break time="0.8s" /> So that no more accidents could happen. <break time="0.8s" /> Hour after hour passed. <break time="0.8s" /> And slowly Dorothy got over her fright. <break time="0.8s" /> Though she felt quite lonely. <break time="0.8s" /> She stopped worrying. <break time="0.8s" /> And decided to wait calmly. <break time="0.8s" /> And see what the future would bring. <break time="0.8s" /> At last she crawled. <break time="0.8s" /> Over the swaying floor. <break time="0.8s" /> To her little bed. <break time="0.8s" /> And Toto. <break time="0.8s" /> Who followed her. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay down beside her. <break time="0.8s" /> In spite of the wailing wind. <break time="0.8s" /> Dorothy soon closed her eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> And fell fast asleep.
